title: Vienna sit-in against deportation to Afghanistan at Rossauer Lände
location: Rossauer Lände near the Polizeianhaltezentrum, Alsergrund, Vienna
participants_original: Akin chronology says 23 people took part; ORF independently quotes police that 23 people blocked the detention center. Total public gathering size is unstated.
threshold_50_evidence: Unknown: the reported number (23) counts people blocking the facility, but the report does not establish whether this was the entire public gathering. Do not infer that the event was below 50.

start_date.summary: ORF dates the sit-in to Tuesday 15 December, 13:00–16:00.

end_date.summary: ORF says the unregistered demonstration lasted 13:00–16:00 and was declared dissolved.

location.summary: Rossauer Lände near the detention facility in Vienna.

participants.summary: ORF attributes 23 people blocking the facility to police; Akin says 23 participants in total. The meeting total remains a threshold-review issue because neither account describes the full crowd clearly.

demands.summary: Opposed Austria’s planned deportation of rejected asylum seekers to Afghanistan.

state_response.summary: Police declared the demonstration dissolved, carried 21 from roadway, and lowered two from light poles; no injuries or criminal charges reported, with citations under assembly law.

protester_violence.summary: Unknown; the report describes participants as cooperative, but does not explicitly code absence of all protester violence.

notes: Separate from the 10 December demonstration announced for the Afghan embassy: this was a sit-in at Rossauer Lände on the deportation date, five days later. A later activist account also describes the 15 December action but is not yet opened or independently verified. Akin chronology also says a further march headed to the Interior Ministry around 17:00; retained as a separate pending-threshold action candidate below.
open_questions: Total gathering size unknown; the reported 23 blockaders cannot establish the >=50 threshold.
Named organizer unknown.
